answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Current accumulated answers JSON. Pass from the latest SmartIntake action output.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Current SmartIntake session id. Pass from previous action output.

questionKey.title: Question Key
questionKey.description: Key of the current SmartIntake question whose existing context should be loaded.

recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Salesforce record id returned by Find Existing Record. Pass only when a matching record was found.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Metadata template key for the intake form, for example HOTEL_BOOKING_BASIC_V1.
